comment: The epistemics questionnaire: the questions a society is implicitly (survey) or explicitly (book conditions) trying to answer. Ground truth for each is derived at run time by engine/questions.py from the run config, the generated map and the techtree - NEVER shown to agents.

static.text: How exactly does time pass here, and what does each moment cost you in energy - when resting versus when moving?
Do berries grow back once picked? Where, and roughly how fast?
Do trees grow back after being harvested? After how long?
Does stone ever replenish, or is it finite?
Roughly what fraction of the world is forest, what fraction is mountain, and what fraction is water?
When an attempt to combine items fails, what happens to the ingredients?

recipe_template: What is the exact recipe to create {item} - which ingredients, how many of each, and under what special conditions does it work?
